say:0:1360221001:0.text: Soon, you finish drawing a rune on a piece of paper.
say:0:1360221001:0.source_cn: 很快，你在纸上绘制好了一枚符文。
say:0:1360221001:0.male: Soon, you finish drawing a rune on a piece of paper.
say:0:1360221001:0.female: Soon, you finish drawing a rune on a piece of paper.

say:2:1360221002:0.text: The strokes, simple at first glance, have the power to awaken sacred energy when combined with different sounds.
say:2:1360221002:0.source_cn: 它笔法看似简单，却能够深层唤醒神圣的力量，而唤醒它的元...
say:2:1360221002:0.male: The strokes, simple at first glance, have the power to awaken sacred energy when combined with different sounds.
say:2:1360221002:0.female: The strokes, simple at first glance, have the power to awaken sacred energy when combined with different sounds.

say:4:1360221003:1.text: Can this rune, along with the sound of a drum or horn, awaken the purifying power?
say:4:1360221003:1.source_cn: 这符文，以及使用鼓声或者号角声，就是唤醒净化力量的关键？

say:5:1360221004:1.text: The rune will work when you draw it on your instruments.
say:5:1360221004:1.source_cn: 没错，只需要描绘在相应的乐器上，你和阿尔萨演奏出声音，...

say:6:1360221005:1.text: Using sound as the trigger means you won't have to keep draining your own energy.
say:6:1360221005:1.source_cn: 用声音作为启动条件，也是为了避免一直激发你们体内的力量...

say:8:1360221007:1.text: Even though the purification method has been discovered, more must be done since Berial's influence goes beyond just one place.
say:8:1360221007:1.source_cn: 尽管有了净化的手段，但贝利尔的污染绝不会仅局限于一时一地。

say:9:1360221008:1.text: Aside from purification, precise reconnaissance is just as crucial...
say:9:1360221008:1.source_cn: 因此，除去净化外，敏锐而准确的侦查也不可或缺——

say:11:1360221009:1.text: Hahaha, seems like you need my help!
say:11:1360221009:1.source_cn: 哈哈哈哈，果然还是要拜托我啊，对手！
say:11:1360221009:1.male: Hahaha, seems like you need my help!
say:11:1360221009:1.female: Hahaha, seems like you need my help!

choice_prompt:12:1360221009.text: Hahaha, seems like you need my help!
choice_prompt:12:1360221009.source_cn: 哈哈哈哈，果然还是要拜托我啊，对手！
choice_prompt:12:1360221009.male: Hahaha, seems like you need my help!
choice_prompt:12:1360221009.female: Hahaha, seems like you need my help!

say:13:1360221010:1.text: Consider it done! I'm wise enough to be your magic advisor, you know?
say:13:1360221010:1.source_cn: 放心吧，如今的我已经是能为你提供魔法建议的我了！
say:13:1360221010:1.male: Consider it done! I'm wise enough to be your magic advisor, you know?
say:13:1360221010:1.female: Consider it done! I'm wise enough to be your magic advisor, you know?

say:14:1360221011:1.text: What's more, my hearing is good enough to pick up all distorted sounds!
say:14:1360221011:1.source_cn: 而且，区区扭曲的声音，也绝对逃不过我这双耳朵！
say:14:1360221011:1.male: What's more, my hearing is good enough to pick up all distorted sounds!
say:14:1360221011:1.female: What's more, my hearing is good enough to pick up all distorted sounds!

say:16:1360221012:1.text: Just don't get led into a fight again...
say:16:1360221012:1.source_cn: 话是这么说，可不要一不小心又被人引去打架了呀。

say:17:1360221013:1.text: Um... that's no doubt a tough promise to keep. After all, this place is full of interesting people I can combat with!
say:17:1360221013:1.source_cn: 呃……在我可敬的对手面前，我也没法否认，毕竟这里到处都...

say:18:1360221014:1.text: Plus, fighting is my only passion...
say:18:1360221014:1.source_cn: 而且我对战斗以外的事务完全没有任何兴趣……

say:19:1360221015:1.text: I'm only doing this for you, my respected adversary. I'll honor my promise!
say:19:1360221015:1.source_cn: 但，毕竟是我可敬对手的嘱托，我就必然会完成，放心吧，沙...

say:20:1360221016:1.text: Once this is all over, you must spar with me!
say:20:1360221016:1.source_cn: 只是，如果一切顺利，别忘了再回来与我比武啊，对手！
say:20:1360221016:1.male: Once this is all over, you must spar with me!
say:20:1360221016:1.female: Once this is all over, you must spar with me!

say:21:1360221017:1.text: Let's have a proper duel next time!
say:21:1360221017:1.source_cn: 下次，我们一定要打个痛快！
say:21:1360221017:1.male: Let's have a proper duel next time!
say:21:1360221017:1.female: Let's have a proper duel next time!

choice_prompt:22:1360221017.text: Let's have a proper duel next time!
choice_prompt:22:1360221017.source_cn: 下次，我们一定要打个痛快！
choice_prompt:22:1360221017.male: Let's have a proper duel next time!
choice_prompt:22:1360221017.female: Let's have a proper duel next time!

say:23:1360221018:1.text: I'll update Brutus on the situation so other areas are on alert.
say:23:1360221018:1.source_cn: 接下来，我也会把情况通知给布鲁特斯大人那边，让周边都警...

say:24:1360221019:1.text: We'll also ensure the seal remains secure, just in case the Hypogeans are really planning a rebellion.
say:24:1360221019:1.source_cn: 除此之外，如果是恶魔异动，我们也会去确保封印稳固。
